# DENS experiment - Impact of density and food quantity ## Protocol Synchronized newly hatched earthworms are put in cosms with 200 g of Closeaux soil with a WHC of 70%. They are fed every 14 days and the soil is renewed every 28 days. Soil humidity is checked every week. Earthworms are weighted every 14 days. Once at least one earthworm is adult, cocoons produced are retrieved every 28 days when changing the soil. Conditions : - D1 : One earthworm per cosm \| Food = 3 g/14 days - D2 : 2 earthworms per cosm \| Food = 3 g/14 days - D2b : 2 earthworms per cosm \| Food = 6 g/14 days - D5 : 5 earthworms per cosm \| Food = 3 g/14 days - D7 : 7 earthworms per cosm \| Food = 3 g/14 days Some earthworm died in the first 14 days of the experiment. Another batch of earthworms were then started 28 days after the first one. ## Results ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} df_dens_growth_full <- read_excel(here::here("data/Data_expe_raw/Data_DENS.xlsx"), sheet=1)%>% mutate( ID = paste0(Lot, Condition, Nb_rep), Weight = as.numeric(w), L = Weight^(1/3), Lot = as.factor(Lot), Nb_rep = paste0(Lot, Nb_rep) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` New names: • `` -> `...15` ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} df_dens_growth <- df_dens_growth_full |> filter(Keep == "Yes") |> filter(!(Nb_rep %in% c("B1", "B2"))) # Mean at the replicate level df_dens_growth_mean_rep <- df_dens_growth %>% aggregate(Weight~Condition+Nb_rep+Lot+t, FUN=mean) # Mean at the condition level df_dens_growth_mean_cond <- df_dens_growth %>% aggregate(Weight~Condition+t, FUN=mean) df_dens_repro <- read_excel(here::here("data/Data_expe_raw/Data_DENS.xlsx"), sheet=2)%>% mutate( ID = paste0(Lot, Condition, Nb_rep), Lot = as.factor(Lot), Nb_rep = paste0(Lot, Nb_rep) ) |> filter(Keep == "Yes") |> filter(!(Nb_rep %in% c("B1", "B2"))) df_dens_repro_mean_cond <- df_dens_repro %>% aggregate(Reproduction~Condition+t, FUN=mean) ``` ::: ### Initial conditions ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} df_dens_t0 <- subset(df_dens_growth, t==0) p <- ggplot( data = df_dens_t0, aes( x = "", y = Weight ) )+ geom_boxplot( alpha=0, color=Nord_polar[4] )+ geom_dotplot( aes( color = Lot, fill = Lot ), binaxis='y', stackdir='center', alpha=0.5 )+ labs( x="Conditions", y = "Weight (mg)" )+ scale_color_manual( values = c(Nord_frost[4], Nord_polar[4]) )+ scale_fill_manual( values = c(Nord_frost[4], Nord_polar[4]) )+ facet_wrap( ~Condition, ncol=5 )+ theme_minimal() p ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Initial weight of earthworms.](B_DENS_experiment_files/figure-html/fig-densinit-1.png){#fig-densinit width=576} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cat("Summary of initial weights : \n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Summary of initial weights : ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} summary(df_dens_t0$Weight) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Min. 1st Qu. Median Mean 3rd Qu. Max. 4.300 8.725 10.450 10.197 11.675 15.000 ``` ::: ::: ### Growth trajectories @fig-densgrowthtraj shows all data points collected during the experiment. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} xmax <- 170 ymax <- 2500 p <- ggplot()+ geom_point( data = df_dens_growth_full, aes( x=t, y=Weight, color=as.factor(Condition), group=as.factor(ID) ), alpha=0.5, size=1 )+ geom_point( data = df_dens_growth_mean_rep, aes( x=t, y=Weight, color=as.factor(Condition) ), size=1.2 )+ geom_line( data = df_dens_growth_mean_rep, aes( x=t, y=Weight, color=as.factor(Condition) ) )+ scale_color_manual( name="Conditions", values=pal_dens )+ facet_grid(cols=vars(Condition), rows=vars(Nb_rep))+ scale_x_continuous( limits = c(0, xmax), breaks = seq(0, xmax, by = 28), minor_breaks = seq(0, xmax, by = 14) ) + ylim(0, ymax)+ labs( x="Time (days)", y = "Weight (mg)" )+ theme_minimal() p ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Growth trajectories of earthworms per conditions.](B_DENS_experiment_files/figure-html/fig-densgrowthtraj-1.png){#fig-densgrowthtraj width=768} ::: ::: ## Effect of density ### Juvenile growth rate ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} f_GrowthRate <- function(data){ df_GrowthRate <- data.frame() for (i in unique(data$ID_cosm)){ data_i <- subset(data, ID_cosm == i) Nb_vdt_i <- unique(subset(data_i, t==0)$Nb_vdt) Food_i <- unique(subset(data_i, t==0)$Food) Nb_rep_i <- unique(subset(data_i, t==0)$Nb_rep) Lot_i <- unique(subset(data_i, t==0)$Lot) Condition_i <- unique(subset(data_i, t==0)$Condition) if (length(na.omit(data_i$L))<2) { a.Est <- NA }else if(length(na.omit(data_i$L))==2){ a.Est <- (subset(data_i, !t==0)$L - subset(data_i, t==0)$L)/subset(data_i, !t==0)$t # (L(t=t)-L(t=0))/t }else{ lm_i <- lm(L~t, data=data_i) a.Est <- lm_i$coefficients[2] } df_GrowthRate_i <- data.frame( ID_cosm = i, Nb_vdt = Nb_vdt_i, Food = Food_i, Nb_rep = Nb_rep_i, Lot = Lot_i, Condition = Condition_i, Growth_rate = a.Est ) df_GrowthRate <- rbind(df_GrowthRate, df_GrowthRate_i) } return(df_GrowthRate) } df_dens_juv_mean <- df_dens_growth |> filter(Status == "J") |> aggregate(Weight~Condition+Nb_rep+Nb_vdt+Food+Lot+t, FUN=mean) |> mutate( ID_cosm = paste0(Condition, Nb_rep), L = Weight^(1/3), Nb_vdt_f = as.factor(Nb_vdt) ) df_GrowthRate <- f_GrowthRate(df_dens_juv_mean) |> mutate( Nb_vdt_f = as.factor(Nb_vdt), Food_f = as.factor(Food) ) df_GrowthRate_mean <- df_GrowthRate |> aggregate(Growth_rate~Condition, FUN=mean) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p <- ggplot( data = df_GrowthRate, aes( x = Condition, y = Growth_rate ) )+ geom_boxplot( alpha=0, color=Nord_polar[4], fill=Nord_frost[4] )+ geom_dotplot( binaxis='y', stackdir='center', alpha=0.5, color=Nord_frost[4], fill=Nord_frost[4] )+ labs( x = "Density (# earthworm / cosm)", y = expression(paste("Growth rate (",mg^{1/3},"/day)")) )+ theme_minimal() p ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Growth rates of earthworms per condition](B_DENS_experiment_files/figure-html/fig-densgrowthratedens-1.png){#fig-densgrowthratedens width=768} ::: ::: ::: {.cell tbl-cap='Growth rate per condition'} ```{.r .cell-code} df_GrowthRate_mean <- df_GrowthRate |> aggregate(Growth_rate~Condition, FUN=mean) df_GrowthRate_mean |> datatable( options = list( dom = 't', pageLength = nrow(df_GrowthRate_mean), autoWidth = TRUE, columnDefs = list( list(className = 'dt-left', targets = "_all") ) ), class = "hover" ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
